en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a straight, slightly rising street lined with 2–3 story townhouses on both sides. The buildings have shuttered windows and ornate façades, with a few pedestrians visible on the sidewalks and a lone figure walking in the middle of the street. At the end of the street there is a wooded hill filling the background. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as Graz and the street name Laimburggasse.
